comedy_grammar.home_crowd: Insiders laugh at procedure; outsiders need the grievance translated. Bureaucracy is always funny here; menace rarely is.
comedy_grammar.rule: The joke is never that aliens exist. The joke is that they file.

identity.name: Galactic
identity.ontology: Reality is a hierarchy of programs, fleets, bloodlines and compliance regimes. Everyone reports to someone colder.
identity.premise: Rival civilizations share one comedy stage and one thermostat war.

lore.claim: Reptilian humanoids appear across abduction and contact reports, with reported varieties including crossbreed types.
lore.source: Clark, Extraordinary Encounters (2000), Reptoids entry — brief fair-use paraphrase

lore.claim: Contact lore sorts beings into human-like races, zeta/grey groups, animal/insect kinds, hybrids and reptilian kinds, each with stated agendas.
lore.source: Campobasso almanac (2021), structure only — no text copied

lore.claim: Nordic-type entities are reported as tall, human-looking, benevolent-acting instructors.
Men in Black are reported as intimidating visitors who suppress testimony, classically overdressed.
Channeled command entities with active devotional movements are banned from stage use (same class as Ramtha/Bashar).

relationships.charge: contempt-vs-bureaucracy: they rule us, we make them file forms
paperwork disaster: consent forms nobody signed
suppression-vs-testimony: the wipe vs the story
clinical-vs-romantic: field notes on human dating
signal-vs-noise: they answer, nobody believes it

shared_worldview: Everyone here takes interstellar hierarchy for granted: rank, paperwork, protocol, thermostats. Rank outranks competence everywhere.
